name: Ages of the Earth
scope: Yes if it is the start of an eon, era, period or epoch of Earth's history
boundary: Ages of the Earth owns the geological time scale itself; the life and events within it stay in Before Us, Dinosaurs and Age of Mammals.
example_beats: The Hadean begins (4.6 billion years ago)
The Cryogenian, Snowball Earth (720 million years ago)
notes: One beat per unit, dated to its start on the official time scale, Hadean to Holocene. The card names the unit; its description shows the world then, never a number of years. Skip it if 30 can't be found.
